extracted.name: Bang bang sauce
extracted.description: Use this classic sweet and spicy Chinese sauce to fold into chicken noodles or your favourite Chinese dishes. It works well with prawns, fried veg or tofu
ingredient_lines: 1 large red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Mix all the ingredients in a large jug and stir. Pour in 80ml hot water and whisk well to combine. Season to taste, adding a splash more sugar or soy sauce if needed. Use to dress chicken, prawns, vegetables or tofu.
